text:
tess: noticed a regression in short-response p95 on host after yesterday's change. profiling points to extra CPU in proto decode + more write syscalls.

omar: saw it too. flame: host > tokenize -> proto_parse_unpacked -> writev_loop. syscall rate per request up ~3x.

vik: what changed in the deploy? any kernel-selection hints or batching heuristics tweaked?

juan: two changes: (1) switched kernel hint to prefer wide-lanes for general decode; (2) added an early-unpack stage in host preproc to try to speed up larger-seq requests. Both behind flags.

omar: early-unpack seems to increase host-side parse CPU for small requests. for tiny sequences the unpack is doing unnecessary work.

bench-bot: quick numbers:
- tiny-chat baseline_p95=38ms
- postchange_p95=52ms
- early_unpack_off_p95=42ms
- kernel-hint-off_p95=44ms
(syscall_artifact/url)
